parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description:
The switch. Valid values:

- **on**: enabled.
- **off**: disabled.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description:
The region in which IPv6 is enabled. Default value: x.x.

- x.x: global.
- cn.cn: Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The website ID, which can be obtained by calling [ListSites](~~2850189~~).
